rationales.deterministic-orchestration-v2: form (a) + form (c) — SGCR’s implemented and evaluated top-level code pipeline fixes the dual-path sequence and dispatches LLMs as bounded workers: parallel explicit reviewers feed an aggregator, while the implicit path runs proposer → retrieval → verifier ensemble → aggregation, followed by final cross-path aggregation.
